normal: Readable S-neck, folded wing and two planted feet. Continuous breast-to-shoulder construction; broad light/dark wing planes survive 64x45.
ascended: Raised wing and reaching leg alter silhouette and support structure. One foot grips the higher reed while the other bears weight on root. Unequal wing contours avoid a mirrored trophy.
holds: Copper crest/wing leading edge reads as fitted ornamental metal rather than natural plumage; this interpretation needs user review before any game direction.
Background root/foliage is busier than existing Hearth portraits at 64x45. Material simplification and frame fitting would be adoption work.
no_reroll: Retain as a distinct expansion direction. Ornament concern does not justify an unrequested paid material reroll.
